glosses: to furnish (to add furniture and equipment to a place)
to prepare, to set up (to make a place ready for or good for some purpose)
to throw, to organize (a party, wedding, or some event)
to settle, to make a home for oneself
to set oneself up (to ensure a high standard of living for oneself, to ensure that one will have a high-paying job)

examples.text: Wszystkie pokoje są klimatyzowane, dobrze wyposażone i urządzone w typowo afrykańskim stylu.
